name: sandiego-municipal-code
description: Authoritative MCP for the City of San Diego municipal code, information bulletins, permits, code-enforcement, zoning, and parcel data. Every response includes machine-readable freshness, citations, and PDF source links. Built by Estate Atlas.

required.name: SANDIEGO_MCP_DATABASE_URL
required.description: Postgres connection string (read-only role) pointing at the San Diego municipal data warehouse. Falls back to DATABASE_URL.

required.name: SANDIEGO_MCP_VOYAGE_API_KEY
required.description: Voyage AI API key (Anthropic's embedding partner), used to embed search queries (voyage-4-large, 1024 dims). Falls back to VOYAGE_API_KEY.

optional.name: SANDIEGO_MCP_EMBEDDING_MODEL
optional.description: Override the embedding model (must match the model the DB was re-indexed with).

optional.name: SANDIEGO_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
optional.description: Log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR). Logs go to stderr.
